form.title: Child and Dependent Care Expenses
form.notes: refundable: false. For tax year 2025 the credit for child and dependent care expenses is entirely NONREFUNDABLE: line 11 goes to Schedule 3 Part I line 2 and line 10 limits it to tax liability. No part of it is refundable for 2025. The temporary refundability granted by the American Rescue Plan applied to tax year 2021 only. P.L. 119-21 raises the top applicable percentage from 35% to 50%, but only for tax years beginning after December 31, 2025 — the 2025 form still prints the 35%-to-20% table at line 8, which is the primary evidence that the old rate is what is in force for 2025. Expense caps for 2025: $3,000 for one qualifying person, $6,000 for two or more (lines 3 and 27). Line 26 is not a credit at all — it is taxable dependent care benefits and lands in income on Form 1040 line 1e. Printed revision: Form 2441 (2025), Created 3/18/25.
